_comment: Microsoft Store pricing for WSL Manager: the listing is free, and Pro is bought on wslmanager.com.
This is the file a release publishes (the Publish to Microsoft Store workflow defaults to it).
priceId Free with an empty marketSpecificPricings clears every per-market price; markets the
clone marks NotAvailable are kept by scripts/store_pricing.jq, because that is availability,
not price. The paid tiers this replaced are in store/pricing-paid.json for rolling back.
The app agrees: storeFreeFromUtc in lib/components/constants.dart names the instant the listing
goes free, and this file must never publish before a build carrying it is on the way — the
same workflow run does both. See doc/microsoft-store-freemium.md.
